Developed Calabi–Yau manifolds.
Advanced complex differential geometry and Kähler geometry.

name: Simon Stevin
title: Developed decimal fraction notation.
Formulated systematic algebraic notation for arithmetic operations.
Advanced early statics and mechanics models.

name: Sofia Kovalevskaya
title: Solved the Kovalewskaya top in rigid body motion.
Proved existence theorem for analytic solutions of differential equations.

name: Sophus Lie
title: Developed Lie groups.
Formulated Lie algebras.
Advanced continuous symmetry theory in differential equations.

name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
title: Developed infinite series for π.
Formulated mock theta functions.
Derived Ramanujan identities in number theory.

name: Stanislaw Ulam
title: Developed Monte Carlo methods.
Formulated Ulam's problem in set theory.
Advanced cellular automata theory.

name: Stefan Banach
title: Developed functional analysis.
Formulated Banach spaces.
Established Hahn–Banach theorem.

name: Stephen Hawking
title: Formulated Hawking radiation.
Developed singularity theorems in general relativity.
Proved black hole area theorem.

name: Stephen Smale
title: Proved the Smale horseshoe map.
Solved parts of the Poincaré conjecture in higher dimensions.
Developed dynamical systems theory.

name: Talithia Williams
title: Applied statistical modeling to healthcare outcomes.
Developed data science methods in public health analytics.

name: Terence Tao
title: Solved Erdős combinatorial problems in number theory.
Developed additive combinatorics (e.g., Tao–Green theorem on primes).
Advanced harmonic analysis and PDE theory.

name: Thābit ibn Qurra
title: Developed formulas for amicable numbers.
Advanced early work in number theory and geometry of proportions.

name: Thales of Miletus
title: Proved that the angle in a semicircle is a right angle.
Developed early deductive geometric reasoning methods.

name: Thomas Bayes
title: Formulated Bayes' theorem:
[[math]] P(A|B) = \frac{P(B|A)P(A)}{P(B)}
Developed inverse probability theory foundations.

name: Vito Volterra
title: Formulated the Volterra integral equations.
Developed population dynamics models.
Advanced functional analysis of integral operators.

name: Vladimir Arnold
title: Developed Arnold's theory of dynamical systems.
Formulated KAM theory (Kolmogorov–Arnold–Moser theorem).
Advanced singularity theory and catastrophe theory.

name: Vladimir Vapnik
title: Developed Vapnik–Chervonenkis theory.
Formulated support vector machines.
Established statistical learning theory.

name: Wang Zhenyi
title: Developed early algebraic geometry methods in calendrical computation.
Formulated mathematical methods for astronomy and surveying.

name: William Rowan Hamilton
title: Formulated quaternions.
Developed Hamiltonian mechanics.
Established Hamiltonian operator formalism in physics.

name: William Thurston
title: Proved geometrization conjecture for Haken manifolds.
Formulated Thurston's geometrization program.
Developed hyperbolic 3-manifold theory.

name: Witfield Diffie
title: Co-developed Diffie–Hellman key exchange.
Formulated public-key cryptography principles.

name: Yang Hui
title: Developed Pascal triangle variants in Chinese mathematics.
Formulated Yang Hui triangle identities.

name: Yann LeCunn
title: Developed convolutional neural networks (LeNet).
Advanced deep learning architectures for computer vision.
Formulated backpropagation improvements for neural nets.

name: Yitang Zhang
title: Proved bounded gaps between primes.
Established first finite bound on prime gaps (Zhang's theorem).

name: Yoshua Bengio
title: Developed deep learning optimization methods.
Advanced neural network training algorithms for representation learning.

name: Yuri Matiyasevich
title: Proved the undecidability of Hilbert's Tenth Problem.
Formulated results in computability theory for Diophantine equations.

name: Zu Chongzhi
title: Computed π to extreme precision using polygon approximation.
Developed early numerical approximation methods for circles.

name: Évariste Galois
title: Developed Galois theory.
Formulated group theory of polynomial solvability.
Proved conditions for solvability of equations by radicals.
